passage:
12 March, 11:40 pm
Can't sleep. Chemistry board exam in two days, and my shoulders are up near my ears. My legs won't stop jiggling under the desk. Every time I close the book my head goes: what if I blank, what if I score less than Tushar did, what if Papa goes quiet like last year, what if I don't get in anywhere at all. Each what-if makes my breath shorter.
Tonight Tushar knocked, saw my face and said, "You've done three past papers today. Go and walk on the terrace. Ten minutes." I went. The air was cool. I breathed out slowly, counting to six. My shoulders came down a bit.
When I came back I made a list of what's actually left: two chapters. That's doable. Last what-if tonight: what if I'm more ready than I think?
Usha

You asked how exam prep is going, so here's the honest version. My shoulders are tight all day, like someone is pressing them down. Thank you for asking properly.
Love,
Reena
